_verbs_as_data_note: v2.0.0: the instruction-verb inventories are GRAPH DATA, not rule-body literals. Each covered verb is a held Concept{name:<verb>, instruction_route:<route>} seeded below; the rules match a Message's predicate Mention resolving (seeds/intent.json's rule_mention_resolves_to_concept, wired by _backfill_knows_concept at ingest) to a Concept whose instruction_route names the faculty -- the note_reported_gap deficiency-concept pattern, applied to verbs. Duplicate same-name Concepts from other seeds (learned_lexicon etc.) are harmless: the referent rule wires the Mention to EVERY same-named held Concept (batch match), and the Exists here finds the route-carrying one. EXTENSIBLE AT RUNTIME: teach(agent, 'Concept', {'name': 'dance', 'instruction_route': 'world_action'}) makes a previously-unhandled verb route through the same rules with NO rule edit -- verb coverage is data the agent can be taught.
description: Graph-native conversation migration (plan: 'comprehend -> mint goal -> reply, no Python ladder'): instruction cases moved off the Python decision ladder (domains/conversation_action.act_on_instruction) onto graph rules. The adapter WRITES the mechanical parse of an inbound utterance onto its Message as graph data (comp_kind, comp_predicate, comp_content -- substrate/world_adapter.py::_write_comprehension_to_graph, which also mints the agent -received-> Message edge these rules match on, the sd 'agent observed obs' pattern -- NEVER ['agent','is_a','Agent'], whose type triple expands to many bindings and over-fires); these rules DECIDE. PHASE 1 (comprehend_read_instruction): a 'read'/'comprehend' instruction whose content is already modeled internally (its tokens are Mention nodes minted at ingest -- reading inline text needs no external world, the comprehension IS the internal model) mints a Goal{kind:comprehend_text} + a comprehends/comprehended_by link + a StringConcat reply over the extracted content, so converse() surfaces a graph-produced reply instead of act_on_instruction's 'no attached world/faculty' floor. PHASE 2 (instruction_world_action_floor): a physical/world-action instruction verb (open/run/move/... -- the Concept inventory below, deliberately DISJOINT from the self-report verbs, so no regression) with no world attached mints a Goal{kind:instruction} + the honest action-space-limit reply -- the SAME honest floor act_on_instruction produced, now graph-produced. Modeled on seeds/composer_comprehension_graph.json (Message -> Goal) + seeds/conversation_reply.json (outbound reply Message). The comprehended attr is the fixpoint-safety guard (mint once per Message), the idiom shape_decode_loop's status guards use. Text realization is deliberately MINIMAL (single StringConcat); routing substantive comprehension/self-report replies through the full production faculty is the remaining Phase 2 work.
